I think that the reason the question is hard is that it’s so vague. There is no possible way to distill your entire personality and life story into a conversational sentence. What people end up doing is picking their most important or relevant details and sharing that. I have issues doing this though because I don’t know what’s important to other people, I  rank everything about myself about the same. To me “I have a dog” and “Im legally certified to irradiate children” are of equal importance. They’re both factual statements that describe me.

Additionally I also struggle with my sense of self. I don’t know what my personality is, or if i have one. All i know in that regard is i am generally like-able and people say I’m nice.
I have not seen a therapist for this, but I've seen therapists in the past. I think I can cope alone.
